surface.$description: Main background of panels and controls. Pairs with text-primary and text-subtle.

surface-raised.$description: Background a step above surface: assistant messages, suggestions, and the rate-limit notice.

text-primary.$description: Body text on surface, surface-raised, danger-surface, and warning-surface.

text-subtle.$description: Secondary text: placeholders, status, empty body. Still meets 4.5:1 on surface and surface-raised.

border.$description: Decorative dividers and outlines that are not needed to identify a control.

border-strong.$description: Control boundaries that identify an input or button. Meets 3:1 on surface.

action.$description: Primary action fill, such as Send. Pairs with text-on-action.

text-on-action.$description: Text and icons on action fills.

danger.$description: Error text, icons, and outlines. Meets 4.5:1 on danger-surface.

warning.$description: Warning text, icons, and dividers, such as the offline banner's. Meets 4.5:1 on warning-surface.

inset-sm.$description: Compact padding: vertical bubble padding, chips, field trailing edge.

inset-md.$description: Default padding inside surfaces: panel sections and horizontal bubble padding.

gap-sm.$description: Gap between items in a row or a short stack.

control.$description: Corner radius of inputs, buttons, chips, and notices.

weight-strong.$description: Weight for titles and button labels.

size-caption.$description: Status lines, notices, chips, and button labels.

line-height-body.$description: Line height multiplier for message text.

duration-instant.$description: Near-immediate feedback, such as the composer growing a line. Collapses to 0.01ms under reduced motion.

duration-fast.$description: Hover and icon changes. Collapses to 0.01ms under reduced motion.

duration-base.$description: Color and opacity changes. Collapses to 0.01ms under reduced motion.

duration-slow.$description: A notice or message appearing. Collapses to 0.01ms under reduced motion.

duration-loop.$description: One cycle of a looping indicator, such as the loading dots. Registered loops park on a static frame under reduced motion.

easing-standard.$description: Default curve for state changes that start and end on screen.

easing-emphasized.$description: Curve for a change the user should notice. Not used by any named use yet.

easing-entrance.$description: Decelerating curve for content entering the view. Entrances are dropped under reduced motion.

easing-linear.$description: Constant rate for loops, such as the loading dots.

use-hover.$description: Hover and press feedback on controls. Expanded where applied; never a custom property.

use-message-enter.$description: A new message entering the log. An entrance: dropped under reduced motion.

use-notice.$description: A notice or banner appearing or leaving.

use-loop.$description: One cycle of a registered looping animation, such as the loading dots or streaming caret.

size-sm.$description: Icons inside compact controls and status lines, such as Stop, Retry, and the stopped status.

size-md.$description: Icons in Send and in notices, such as the error, rate-limit, and offline icons.
